messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Content Access" as it appears in the following examples.
['Please visit our Customer Verification Form using their link below and following the instructions on the screen.', 'for more information please log on to (http://www.hariri.info/)', 'Please discover new Business Center homepage now: Continue>>', 'By clicking on the link below you will launch the procedure of the client details update: http://ww2.natwest.com/details.aspx?host=28hrdnhfdDwcjjtlctOldbhrOkhOvp', 'By following the link below you will begin the form of the member login approval: http://ww9.abbey-business.net/servlet/?referrer=30rdvrdyodsDwcjjtlctOldbhrOkhOvp', 'Please visit our Client Confirmation Page using the link below and follow the instructions on the screen.', 'Please download the document attached to this email to complete this process.', 'You have 2 new IMPORTANT messages waiting in your inbox folder.', 'To complete the form, please use the link below: NatWest Customer Form', 'open the attachment in this email to view and complete the form W-8BEN.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
